text:
Predicates:
German(x) ::: x is a German politician.
MemberOfParliament(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
PrussianStateParliament(y) ::: y is the Prussian State Parliament.
NaziReichstag(y) ::: y is the Nazi Reichstag.

Premises:
HeinrichSchmidt is a German politician.
HeinrichSchmidt was a member of the Prussian State Parliament.
HeinrichSchmidt was a member of the Nazi Reichstag.

Conclusion:
∃x (German(x) ∧ MemberOfParliament(x, PrussianStateParliament) ∧ MemberOfParliament(x, NaziReichstag))
